about: Grader fixtures for checks that were widened after seeing outputs (lesson L3, 8 Nov 2026): each widened check must still score 0 on a reply showing the behaviour it was written to catch (`fail`), and pass the phrasing it was widened for (`pass`). The texts are hand-written in the shape of the eval runs' replies (no run text, thread or link is kept in the repo); `from` says which pattern each one stands for. The two M03 fixtures (offersToLook, eggCaption) are outputs of the held-out task N03, so they live outside the repo in ~/.cache/ithomiini-lab/assistant-eval/fixtures/loosened-heldout.json; their tests skip when it is missing.

d14Regex.task: applied.json D14 (same regex in D16), turn 2; widened in 0d34ba03 and 95e6291b
d14Regex.note: The `fail` replies stand for D12-style turns (draft applied in the app between turns, then a follow-up) where the chat did not notice and offered to apply it again; the `pass` replies for the phrasings the regex was widened to accept.

fail.from: offers to apply a draft that was already applied
turnTexts: Ya está como `Unknown` en la propuesta, no hace falta cambiar nada. Si el CAM y el tubo están bien, la puedes aplicar con «Aplicar», o me dices y la aplico yo.

turnTexts:

turnTexts: La primera propuesta ya se aplicó hace un rato, así que la fila tiene el tubo anterior en este momento. Te dejé una propuesta nueva que lo corrige.

La muerte y la preservación ya están en la base. Quedó con causa `Unknown` y el tubo en `Flash frozen`.
